title: Scope manual decision IDs to current branch to prevent cross-branch collisions
context: Manual decision IDs for no-commit captures were colliding when different branches captured same-titled decisions to a shared overlay, causing data loss. But same-branch re-records must still collide (draft-upgrade workflow). Touches invariant(s): con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Embed the current branch (or root path if detached HEAD) into the manual decision ID seed: `manual:<branch-or-root>:<title>`. Since Git forbids checking out the same branch in two worktrees simultaneously, same-branch re-records still collide by design, while different branches now mint different IDs.
consequences: Manual decision ID collisions are now scoped by checkout, preventing silent overwrites in shared overlays
Same-branch re-records still upgrade in place (intended draft-upgrade behavior preserved)
Collision prevention is immediate and structural, not deferred to git merge resolution
alternatives_rejected: Adding worktree ID or session ID would require new tracking outside Git semantics
Fixing collisions only at merge time (mergeHunchJson) is too late—data already lost
